summary: A candidate finishes another race with a history of losses and no victory to point to.
realLife: Norman Thomas lost six presidential races on the Socialist ticket. He had also stood for mayor of New York City and for governor of New York, and finished his political career without winning an election.
inGame: Past election results supply the losses; a complete candidacy history is required to assert no wins.

turns.what: The candidate wins after several unsuccessful races.
turns.pulledBy: The certified return puts them ahead for the first time.
turns.writesBack: The electoral history records a first victory alongside the earlier losses.

turns.what: The candidate waits for a close result to be certified before sending a note to former volunteers.
turns.pulledBy: The unofficial count shows a loss and the elections board still has ballots to review.
turns.writesBack: The campaign adds a defeat to the history only after certification.
